name: ref2va-bakeoff
family: Ref2VA-class speed/identity bake-off (turbo LoRAs and fused checkpoints)
origin: tranche 3a bake-off (Flux muwufpp 66a2ji6) + tranche 3b MATLOWAI arm (a80ekav zhgg33m); scripts ported from test-results/experiments/{tranche3a,tranche3b}/scripts/*bakeoff*/build|run|analyze* and *matlowai*
measures: ArcFace identity vs the reference still at f0/f62/f123 (buffalo_l), wall-clock per arm, and the blind pairwise vision read. Same reference scene, matched prompt+seed across all arms.

fixtures.referenceImage: input/exp_bake/ref.png (derived: tranche-1 srcA frame 40; prep step extracts it if absent)
fixtures.prompt: The woman in <Picture 1>, the same person. A pale woman in her early thirties with a short black bob haircut, thin silver hoop earrings, faint freckles, wearing an oversized rust-orange wool coat over a charcoal turtleneck. She stands at a weathered wooden counter in a small sunlit kitchen, slowly stirring a copper pot of soup with a wooden spoon, late-afternoon light through a window to her left; the camera holds a steady medium shot. Audio: gentle simmering, the wooden spoon tapping the copper pot, a quiet kitchen fan hum.

main8.label: larryvrh v4_step600_ema @8-step MERGE — the measured DEFAULT of the fast tier (neutral-look)

fused4.label: MATLOWAI fused-turbo @4-step (catalog matlowai-fused-turbo-int8) — the measured styled candidate entry (fastest + best identity; Mystic v2.0 style folded in)

l8.label: lightx2v Ref2VA 8-step v1.0 768p — close runner-up (historical arm)

t4.label: official ref2v 4-step (lightx2v publish) — measured NOT usable at 4-step in merge mode (historical arm)

pdd8.label: alibaba-pai PDD Ref2VA-Acc-8Step — measured unloadable on the pruned base (deterministic KeyError; the failure IS the datapoint)

ref20.label: no turbo, euler/simple 20 steps — the quality/identity anchor

candidateSlot.description: A new Ref2VA-class speed option slots in at the pinned scene+seed and is measured against main8 (neutral incumbent) and fused4 (styled incumbent). Two measured classes: a turbo LoRA applied to the pruned base (quantize-then-patch path) or a fused/merged checkpoint loaded by the stock UNETLoader (merged-then-quantized path).

slotFields.file: model file name present in the testbed models tree (loras/ for turbo-lora, diffusion_models/ for fused-checkpoint)
slotFields.steps: sampling steps for the turbo sampler
slotFields.catalogId: optional fetch-catalog id — run.mjs fetches it first (consent pre-recorded per experimentPrerequisite) and surfaces the license at run start

rubric.pair: Two labeled columns (LEFT/RIGHT), same scene and seed. Judge: (1) identity fidelity to the described woman — bob haircut, silver hoop earrings, freckles — are the markers visible and stable? (2) general quality: color fidelity to a sunlit late-afternoon kitchen (no sepia/amber collapse, no waxy smear), distinct hues, no banding; (3) micro-motion naturalness. State which column wins and whether the gap is clear or marginal.
rubric.contact: 12-up contact sheet: judge identity markers, exposure fidelity vs a sunlit kitchen, detail retention, banding.

limits: Identity scores ride the reference-mode ceiling (pose/lighting/resolution bound, not step count) — tranche 3a measured every option inside the 0.12-0.37 ArcFace band with seed spread exceeding between-option gaps; a single seed is directional only.
turbo LoRA arms measure the MERGE path (low_vram=True, the 24GB constraint); a bypass-mode candidate would need the node's non-merge path — record which path a candidate used.
fused checkpoints fold style opinions (e.g. Mystic v2.0 @0.7 in fused4) — a blind win does not mean 'neutral look'; check the style counter before shipping a default.
